items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: No, I never, I never heard them play

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a nice drummer, he was a good man.
Yeah. I remember Baby Dodds, he was a good drummer. Did you ever hear Baby Dodds around Chicago or down there?

No, I never, I never heard them play because you know you get busy around there and you play it at night and you see them places you go to wake up 11, 30 at night and it's 3 or 4 in the morning and you get under you, you stop and get a drink or something, well that's usual, you know what I mean? This is going to stop somewhere. We used to stop 5th to 1st in South Park at the drugstore, they sell liquor and everything down there, you know. They get all the taste and sometimes you stop in them places and be running…
